name: Finance and accounting
description: Banks, lenders, insurers, accountants and finance teams.

typical_workflows.name: Invoice processing
typical_workflows.description: Read invoices, extract amounts and vendors, match to purchase orders.

typical_workflows.name: Expense categorization
typical_workflows.description: Assign expenses to accounts and flag unusual ones.

typical_workflows.name: Customer onboarding / KYC review
typical_workflows.description: Check identity documents and application forms.

typical_workflows.name: Financial report commentary
typical_workflows.description: Write management commentary on monthly numbers.

typical_workflows.name: Client queries
typical_workflows.description: Answer questions about statements, fees and processes.

compliance_notes: Financial and identity data are sensitive; check data-protection and financial-regulator rules (for example GDPR, PCI DSS for card data, local anti-money-laundering rules).
Decisions that affect customers (credit, claims) may need to be explainable and reviewed by a person.
Keep an audit trail of what the AI produced and who approved it.
Exact calculations (totals, tax) should be done by spreadsheets or software, not by an AI model.
follow_up_questions: How many documents or transactions do you handle per month?
Are the documents scanned images, PDFs or structured files?
Is there a regulator or auditor that needs to see how decisions are made?
Does a person approve the output before money moves?
